text: AI is changing how we create art, music, and writing. Today, computers can generate paintings, compose songs, and even write stories. Some people worry that this will replace human creativity, but others believe AI is simply a tool. Human creativity comes from emotions, experiences, and imagination. Machines, however, follow patterns and data. They can copy styles and produce new combinations, but they do not truly feel or understand what they make. Perhaps the best results happen when humans and AI work together. People can guide the creative process, while AI offers new ideas and possibilities. In the end, creativity is still a deeply human quality.
